_INSTRUCTIONS.purpose: Test data template for your application
_INSTRUCTIONS.structure: Each TCId (TestCaseId) maps to a test scenario
_INSTRUCTIONS.mapping: Feature files tagged with @TCId-XXX load data from matching keys in this file
_INSTRUCTIONS.usage: In feature file: @TCId-Example001 loads TCId-Example001 data; use testdata.fieldname in steps
_INSTRUCTIONS.bestPractice: Create one JSON file per feature (e.g., checkout.json, dashboard.json)

TCId-Example001._description: POSITIVE: User successfully registers with valid data

TCId-Example002._description: NEGATIVE: Negative test cases handled via Scenario Outline Examples table
TCId-Example002.note: Use @TCId-Example002 for negative scenarios with Examples table
TCId-Example002.emptyFieldValidation: Use EMPTY placeholder in Examples instead of JSON
